title: 12. The Search for the Wicked Witch

paragraphs.en: The soldier with green whiskers led Dorothy and her companions through the streets of the Emerald City to the Guardian of the Gates' room. After unlocking his spectacles, he politely opened the gate for them.
paragraphs.zh: 绿胡须的士兵带领多萝西和她的同伴穿过翡翠城的街道，来到守门者的房间。他先解锁了自己的眼镜，然后礼貌地为他们打开了大门。

paragraphs.en: "Which road leads to the Wicked Witch of the West?" Dorothy asked.
paragraphs.zh: “通向西方恶巫婆的路是哪条？”多萝西问道。

paragraphs.en: "There is no road," replied the Guardian. "No one wishes to go that way."
paragraphs.zh: “没有这样的路,”守卫回答道,“没有人愿意走这条路。”

paragraphs.en: "How will we find her then?" inquired the girl.
paragraphs.zh: “那我们怎么找到她呢？”女孩问道。

paragraphs.en: "That's easy," said the man. "She'll come for you when she knows you're here, and make you her slaves."
paragraphs.zh: “这很简单，”那人说道，“等她知道你在这里的时候，就会来找你，并让你成为她的奴隶。”

paragraphs.en: "We plan to destroy her," stated the Scarecrow.
paragraphs.zh: “我们打算把她摧毁掉,”稻草人说道。

paragraphs.en: "Oh, that changes things," said the Guardian. "I thought she'd make slaves of you as she has others. Be careful; she's wicked and fierce."
paragraphs.zh: “哦，这就改变了一切，”守护者说道，“我还以为她会像对待其他人一样把你变成奴隶。小心点；她既邪恶又凶猛。”

paragraphs.en: They thanked him and continued westward, walking over soft grass dotted with daisies and buttercups. Dorothy noticed her green dress had turned white, along with Toto's ribbon.
paragraphs.zh: 他们向他道谢，继续往西走，脚下的草地柔软而绵延，点缀着雏菊和金盏花。多萝西注意到自己的绿裙子变成了白色，托托的项圈也是如此。

paragraphs.en: The Emerald City was soon left behind. The ground became rougher and hillier as they advanced into the West, where there were no farms or houses, and the land remained untended.
paragraphs.zh: 翡翠城很快便被抛在了身后。随着他们向西方前进，地面变得越来越崎岖不平，满是丘陵，沿途看不到任何农舍或田地，土地也一直荒废未耕。

paragraphs.en: In the afternoon sun, without trees for shade, Dorothy, Toto, and the Lion grew tired by nightfall. They lay down on the grass to sleep while the Woodman and Scarecrow kept watch.
paragraphs.zh: 在午后阳光的照射下，由于没有树荫，多萝西、托托和狮子王兽逐渐感到疲惫，到了夜晚便躺在草地上休息。伐木工和稻草人则轮流守夜。

paragraphs.en: The Wicked Witch of the West, with one powerful eye like a telescope, saw them from her castle door. Angered to find them in her country, she blew upon a silver whistle around her neck.
paragraphs.zh: 西方恶巫婆从城堡门口望去，她的一只眼睛如同望远镜般锐利。发现他们出现在自己的领地，不禁怒气冲冲，对着脖子上挂着的银色哨子吹了一口气。

paragraphs.en: A pack of fierce wolves approached from all directions, their long legs and sharp teeth ready for action.
paragraphs.zh: 一群凶猛的狼从四面八方逼近，它们长腿利齿，ready for action。

paragraphs.en: The Witch instructed, "Go to those people and tear them apart."
paragraphs.zh: 巫婆命令道：“去找那些人，把他们撕个粉碎。”

paragraphs.en: "Why not make them slaves?" asked the wolf leader.
paragraphs.zh: “为什么不让它们成为奴隶呢？”狼王问道。

paragraphs.en: "None are fit to work," she replied. "Tear them into pieces."
paragraphs.zh: “都不适合工作，”她回答道，“把他们撕成碎片。”

paragraphs.en: The wolf dashed off, followed by his pack.
paragraphs.zh: 狼飞快地奔了出去，身后跟着它的狼群。

paragraphs.en: The Scarecrow and Woodman were awake and heard the wolves coming. The Woodman said, "This is my fight; get behind me."
paragraphs.zh: 稻草人和樵夫已经醒了，听见狼群 approaching。樵夫说道：“这是我的仗；你站在我身后。”

paragraphs.en: He swung his sharp axe, chopping the first wolf's head off. Another fell to his weapon, and so it went until all forty lay dead before him.
paragraphs.zh: 他挥舞着锋利的斧头，砍下了第一只狼的脑袋。另一只狼应声倒下，随后接二连三地倒下，直到四十只狼全部毙命在他的面前。

paragraphs.en: They sat down after the battle, the Scarecrow saying, "Good work, friend."
paragraphs.zh: 他们打完仗坐了下来，稻草人说道：“干得不错，朋友。”

paragraphs.en: Dorothy awoke the next morning, frightened by the pile of wolves. The Tin Woodman explained what happened, and they had breakfast before continuing their journey.
paragraphs.zh: 第二天早上，多萝西醒来时被一堆狼吓了一跳。铁皮人解释了发生的事情，他们吃完早餐后继续上路。

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, the Wicked Witch saw her wolves dead and strangers still in her land. She blew her whistle twice, summoning a flock of wild crows to peck out the travelers' eyes and tear them apart.
paragraphs.zh: 与此同时，恶毒的女巫见自己的狼已死，而陌生人依然在她的领地内。她两次吹响哨子，召唤来一群野Crow，要它们啄瞎旅行者的双眼并将他们撕成碎片。

paragraphs.en: The crows flew towards Dorothy and her companions. The Scarecrow told the little girl, "This is my battle; lie down beside me."
paragraphs.zh: 乌鸦飞向了多萝西和她的同伴们。稻草人对小女孩说：“这是我的战斗；你躺在我的旁边吧。”

paragraphs.en: The Scarecrow stood up, stretching his arms, as crows flew at him in fear. He caught each crow by the head, twisting their necks until they died. Forty crows later, all were dead.
paragraphs.zh: 稻草人站起身来，伸展着双臂。这时，一群乌鸦吓得飞了过来。他一把抓住每只乌鸦的头部，扭断了它们的脖子。四十多只乌鸦过后，全都死了。

paragraphs.en: The Scarecrow called his companions to rise and continued their journey.
paragraphs.zh: 稻草人叫来同伴们起身，继续他们的旅程。

paragraphs.en: Seeing her crows dead, the Wicked Witch blew three times on her silver whistle. A swarm of black bees buzzed in from the air. She commanded them to sting the strangers to death.
paragraphs.zh: 看到自己的乌鸦死掉，恶毒的女巫三次吹响银色的哨子。一群黑色的蜜蜂从空中蜂拥而至。她命令这些蜜蜂将陌生人蜇死。

paragraphs.en: The Woodman saw the bees coming and told the Scarecrow to take out his straw and scatter it over Dorothy, Toto, and the Lion.
paragraphs.zh: 木匠看到蜜蜂飞来，便告诉稻草人拿出稻草撒在多萝西、托托和狮子身上。

paragraphs.en: The straw covered Dorothy and Toto entirely, protecting them as they lay close to the Lion. The bees attacked only the Woodman, their stings breaking against his tin body without harming him. With no more stingers, the bees died, scattered like fine coal around the Woodman.
paragraphs.zh: 稻草完全覆盖住了多萝西和托托，保护着它们紧挨着狮子躺卧的身体。蜜蜂们只攻击了樵夫，但他们的蜇刺在碰触到樵夫那金属般坚硬的身躯时便无功而返，未能造成伤害。随着蜇刺耗尽，蜜蜂们纷纷死去，在樵夫周围散落开来，如同细小的煤灰。

paragraphs.en: Dorothy and the Lion got up, and Dorothy helped the Tin Woodman replace the straw in the Scarecrow. They resumed their journey. The Wicked Witch, enraged by her dead bees, stamped, tore her hair, and gnashed her teeth.
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西和狮子站起身来，多萝西帮铁皮人将稻草人里的稻草重新填好。他们继续前行。巫婆因死去的蜜蜂而怒不可遏，跺着脚，扯着头发，咬牙切齿。

paragraphs.en: She then called twelve Winkies, armed them with spears, and ordered them to destroy the strangers.
paragraphs.zh: 她随后召集了十二名温基士兵，武装他们长矛，并命令他们消灭这些陌生人。

paragraphs.en: The Winkies fled back to the castle in fear after the Lion's roar. The Wicked Witch punished them harshly and sent them away. She then sat to devise her next move.
paragraphs.zh: 狮子一声吼叫，巫婆的爪牙——温基人闻声四散逃回了城堡。面对狮王的威势，这些温基人受到了严厉的惩罚后被驱逐出境。随后，巫婆坐下来冥思苦想，策划着下一步行动。

paragraphs.en: She had used the Golden Cap twice before: once to enslave the Winkies, and another time against Oz himself. Now, with all other options exhausted, she decided to call upon the Winged Monkeys for help.
paragraphs.zh: 她曾两次使用金色魔帽：一次是役使温基人，另一次则是对抗奥兹本人。如今，所有其他选择都已耗尽，她决定召唤有翼猴来寻求帮助。

paragraphs.en: The Witch put on the Golden Cap and recited the incantation three times: "Ep-pe, pep-pe, kak-ke," "Hil-lo, hol-lo, hel-lo," and "Ziz-zy, zuz-zy, zik." Suddenly, a dark sky filled with wings appeared. The Winged Monkeys surrounded her, each with large wings on their shoulders.
paragraphs.zh: 巫婆戴上金帽，念诵咒语三次：“Ep-pe, pep-pe, kak-ke”，“Hil-lo, hol-lo, hel-lo”，以及“Ziz-zy, zuz-zy, zik”。突然间，一片乌云密布，翅膀在其中闪现。展翅的猴子们围绕着她，每只猴子的肩膀上都长着巨大的翅膀。

paragraphs.en: With the monkeys at her command, she felt confident in her plan to destroy Dorothy and her friends.
paragraphs.zh: 在猴子听从她的指挥后，她对自己的计划充满了信心，打算摧毁多萝西和她的朋友们。

paragraphs.en: The largest Winged Monkey approached the Wicked Witch and declared, "You have summoned us for the final time. What do you command?"
paragraphs.zh: 最大的飞猴走近恶巫，宣布道：“你最后一次召唤我们了。你要吩咐什么？”

paragraphs.en: "Go to the strangers within my land," the Witch ordered, "and destroy them all except the Lion. Bring him to me; I wish to harness him like a horse."
paragraphs.zh: 巫婆命令道：“去把我国土里的陌生人全部杀光，除了狮子。把他带给我；我想把他也驯服起来，像马一样使用他。”

paragraphs.en: The leader confirmed, "Your commands shall be obeyed." The Monkeys then flew away with great noise and chattering towards Dorothy and her friends.
paragraphs.zh: 领头的确认道：“你们的命令将会得到遵守。”猴子们随即喧闹着飞向多萝西和她的朋友们。

paragraphs.en: Some seized the Tin Woodman, dropping him onto sharp rocks where he lay battered and immobile. Others pulled all straw from the Scarecrow's clothes and head, bundling it into a tree. Remaining Monkeys tied the Lion tightly with ropes, lifting him to the Witch's castle in a small yard surrounded by an iron fence.
paragraphs.zh: 一些人抓住了锡木人，把他扔在尖锐的岩石上，任由他狼狈不堪地躺在那里动弹不得。另一些人则把稻草人身上的稻草和头上的稻草全部扯下，捆成一团丢进了树上。剩下的猴子用绳子紧紧绑住了狮子，把它抬到了一个铁栅栏围起的小院中的巫婆城堡里。

paragraphs.en: Dorothy watched her friends' fate, fearing her own turn. The leader of the Winged Monkeys approached her, his arms outstretched and face grinning, but stopped when he saw the Good Witch's kiss mark on her forehead. He instructed the others not to harm her.
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西注视着朋友们的命运，担心自己也会轮到。一只翅膀猴子的首领向她走来，双臂张开，脸上带着笑容，但当他看到好巫婆在她额头上的吻痕时，停下了脚步。他命令其他猴子不要伤害她。

paragraphs.en: "We dare not touch this little girl," he said, "as she is protected by the Power of Good, which surpasses Evil." They carefully carried Dorothy to the castle and set her gently on the front doorstep.
paragraphs.zh: 他说：“我们不敢碰这个小女孩，因为她受到善良力量的保护，这种力量超越了邪恶。”他们小心翼地点着将多萝西抬到城堡，并轻轻放在前门廊上。

paragraphs.en: Dorothy's captors declared their obedience, destroying the Tin Woodman and Scarecrow, tying up the Lion, and sparing Dorothy and Toto. The Winged Monkeys flew away, leaving Dorothy free from their control.
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西的囚徒宣布服从命令，摧毁了铁皮人和稻草人，把狮子绑了起来，而放过了多萝西和托托。飞猴们展翅飞去，让多萝西摆脱了他们的控制。

paragraphs.en: The Wicked Witch was surprised by Dorothy’s mark on her forehead but feared for the Silver Shoes on Dorothy's feet. She decided to use Dorothy as a slave, unaware of the shoes' power.
paragraphs.zh: 恶女巫见多萝西额头上的记号大吃一惊，但更担心多萝西脚上那双银鞋。她决定把多萝西当作奴隶使唤，却不知那些鞋子拥有神奇的力量。

paragraphs.en: "Follow me," the Witch commanded harshly, leading Dorothy through her castle until they reached the kitchen. There, Dorothy began cleaning pots and sweeping floors.
paragraphs.zh: “跟我来。”女巫厉声命令道，带领多萝西穿过她的城堡，直到她们来到厨房。在那里，多萝西开始洗锅扫地。

paragraphs.en: Determined to work hard, Dorothy cleaned diligently, relieved that she would not be killed. Meanwhile, the Witch planned to harness the Lion as a horse but was frightened by his fierce roar and shut the gate.
paragraphs.zh: 决心努力工作，多萝西认真打扫，松了一口气，知道自己不会被杀害。与此同时，巫婆打算把狮子驯养起来当马使用，但狮王那震耳欲聋的吼声让她心生畏惧，她赶紧关上了门。

paragraphs.en: "Starve you if you disobey," the Witch threatened through the gate, showing her intention to keep the Lion hungry until he complied.
paragraphs.zh: “如果你不听话，我就让你饿死。”女巫透过门缝威胁道，显然打算让狮子一直挨饿，直到它屈服。

paragraphs.en: Dorothy continued to bring food to the imprisoned Lion daily at noon, asking if he was ready for harnessing. The Lion would threaten her, warning that he would bite her if she entered his yard.
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西每天中午依然会给被囚禁的狮子送食物，并询问他是否准备好套上马具了。狮子威胁她说，如果她敢进入他的院子，他会咬死她。

paragraphs.en: Every night, Dorothy secretly fed the Lion from the cupboard while the woman slept. After eating, the Lion lay on his straw bed, and Dorothy would rest beside him, discussing their troubles and planning escape routes. However, they remained trapped due to constant guard by the yellow Winkies, slaves of the Wicked Witch.
paragraphs.zh: 每晚，多萝西都会偷偷给狮子喂食，而那女人则在一旁熟睡。吃完后，狮子躺在稻草床上呼噜大睡，多萝西便靠着他休息，讨论着各自的困境，并谋划着逃跑的路线。然而，由于 constantly 由黄皮肤温克利人看守，他们始终无法逃脱，这些温克利人是邪恶女巫的奴隶。

paragraphs.en: During the day, Dorothy worked hard, fearing the Witch's threats with her old umbrella. The Witch dared not strike Dorothy because of the mark on her forehead. Once, Toto was struck by the umbrella; in retaliation, he bit the Witch’s leg.
paragraphs.zh: 白天，多萝西努力工作，她害怕巫婆用旧伞威胁她。由于额头上的标记，巫婆不敢打多萝西。有一次，托托被伞击中；作为报复，他咬了巫婆的腿。

paragraphs.en: Despite this, the Witch did not bleed, as her blood had dried up long ago.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管如此，巫婆并没有流血，因为她的血液早已干涸。

paragraphs.en: Dorothy grew increasingly sad, realizing it would be difficult to return home. She often cried for hours, with Toto at her feet, whining sadly out of concern for his mistress. Toto cared only that Dorothy was safe; however, he shared her unhappiness.
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西越来越感到悲伤，意识到回家将会非常困难。她常常整晚哭泣，小托托则坐在她的身旁，为她的主人忧心忡忡地呜咽着。小托托只希望多萝西平安无事；然而，他也分享着她的愁绪。

paragraphs.en: The Wicked Witch coveted Dorothy's Silver Shoes, which the girl wore constantly. Despite losing her bees, crows, and wolves, as well as the power from the Golden Cap, she hoped the shoes would grant her greater control. She watched Dorothy closely but found no opportunity to steal them.
paragraphs.zh: 邪恶巫婆垂涎着多萝西的银鞋，女孩几乎一直穿着它们。尽管失去了蜜蜂、乌鸦和狼，还有金帽赋予的力量，她仍希望银鞋能让她获得更大的掌控权。她密切注视着多萝西，却未能找到偷取鞋子的机会。

paragraphs.en: The child was too proud of her shoes to remove them except at night or during baths.
paragraphs.zh: 这个孩子对自己的鞋子太得意了，除非晚上或洗澡时才会脱下它们。

paragraphs.en: The Witch feared both darkness and water, so she never ventured into Dorothy's room at night nor approached when she bathed. One day, the Wicked Witch devised a cunning plan. She placed an iron bar in the kitchen floor, making it invisible with magic.
paragraphs.zh: 巫婆既怕黑暗又怕水，因此她从不在晚上进入多丽丝的房间，也不在她洗澡时靠近。一天，恶毒的巫婆想出了一个狡猾的计策。她在厨房地板上放了一根铁棒，并用魔法使其隐形。

paragraphs.en: When Dorothy stepped on it, she fell, losing one of her Silver Shoes. The Witch quickly snatched it and put it on her own foot.
paragraphs.zh: 当多萝西踩到那东西时，她一个踉跄摔倒了，一只银鞋也掉了出来。巫婆迅速捡起那只银鞋，给自己穿上了。

paragraphs.en: Pleased by this success, the Witch now owned half the shoes' power. She taunted Dorothy, who angrily demanded the return of her shoe. The Wicked Witch refused, claiming ownership.
paragraphs.zh: 这次成功让女巫欣喜不已，她现在拥有了鞋子一半的力量。她嘲笑多萝西，而多萝西气愤地要求归还她的那双鞋。女巫拒绝了，声称自己拥有这双鞋的所有权。

paragraphs.en: Enraged, Dorothy threw a bucket of water at the Witch, drenching her completely.
paragraphs.zh: 愤怒之下，多萝西朝巫婆泼了一桶水，把她浇得透湿。

paragraphs.en: The wicked witch cried out in fear as she began to shrink. "See what you have done!" she screamed.
paragraphs.zh: 恶毒的巫婆恐惧地喊叫着，身体开始缩小。“看看你干了什么！”她尖叫道。

paragraphs.en: "In a minute I shall melt away."
paragraphs.zh: “一会儿我就要化为乌有了。”

paragraphs.en: Dorothy, frightened by this sight, replied, "I'm very sorry indeed." The witch continued, her voice wailing with despair: "Didn't you know water would be the end of me?"
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西被这景象吓得不轻，回答说：“我真的很抱歉。”女巫接着说道，声音充满了绝望：“你不知道水会要了我的命吗？”

paragraphs.en: "Of course not," Dorothy answered honestly.
paragraphs.zh: “当然不行，”多萝西诚实地回答道。

paragraphs.en: The witch then said, "In a few minutes I shall be all melted, and you will have the castle to yourself. I never thought a little girl like you could melt me." With these words, she fell into a brown, shapeless mass that spread across the kitchen floor.
paragraphs.zh: 巫婆随后说道：“再过几分钟，我就要化为灰烬了，这座城堡就归你独自享用吧。我从没想过一个像你这样的小女孩能让我融化。”说完这些话，她化作一团棕色、毫无形状的物质，蔓延在厨房的地面上。

paragraphs.en: Seeing her completely melted, Dorothy fetched another bucket of water and cleaned up the mess before sweeping it out. She found only the silver shoe left from the witch and cleaned it with a cloth, putting it back on her own foot.
paragraphs.zh: 见她完全融化成一滩水，多萝西又端来一桶水清理干净，然后扫了出去。她只找到了巫婆留下的那只银鞋，用布擦干净后，重新穿回了自己的脚上。

paragraphs.en: Free to move about, Dorothy ran to the courtyard to tell the Lion that the Wicked Witch of the West was gone, and they were no longer prisoners in this strange land.
paragraphs.zh: 自由行动后，多萝西跑向庭院，告诉狮子西方恶巫婆已经离去，她们再也不算是这个StrangeLand的囚徒了。
